quests.title: The Hill Above Cherrybrook
quests.blurb: There is a bench on the hill above Cherrybrook I have watched from a moving bus about fourteen thousand times. I am not going to stop — that is not the kind of person I turned out to be. So you go, at quarter to six, when the light is worth it.

steps.label: up the hill, the way the road does not go
the view I have never stopped for
$72, because I am paying you for it

quests.title: Contesting It at Waterfall
quests.blurb: Done at Waterfall on a wet Monday for something that is only an offence if a sign says so, and nobody upstairs wants to hear it. How do you photograph a thing not being somewhere? That is your problem now.

steps.label: where the sign is supposed to be
photograph the absence, which is harder than it sounds
the one who tells you photography is not allowed here

quests.title: The Strip Outside Kirrawee
quests.blurb: Nobody planted the strip at Kirrawee. I did, on the long weekend, at ten past five, so nobody would ask. I would like the fifteenth to go badly for council.

steps.label: the strip, which is a garden now
the man with the whipper snipper
photograph it while it still exists

quests.title: Night Fill, Villawood
quests.blurb: Started on the week of the show. In off the Villawood late train, gone before the first delivery, every time, and nobody upstairs wants to hear it. Come in on the late one and watch the loading door.

steps.label: come in on the late one like they do
the loading door nobody watches
whoever is standing in it at two in the morning
$108 of what they took, back

quests.title: The Window Above Clyde
quests.blurb: I live above the platform at Clyde and I know this line by sound. Something in the rhythm changed about a month ago and everyone I tell thinks I am mad. Ride it and tell me whether I am mad.

steps.label: ride it and listen to the joins
photograph the stretch that sounds wrong
tell me I am not mad

quests.title: Setting Up at Kingswood
quests.blurb: 18 years in the Kingswood market. The bays are not allocated, they are *known*, and since the first of the month somebody has decided that knowing does not count, and I am the only one who seems to have noticed.

steps.label: the bays, at the hour it happens
the bloke with the extra trestle
you will want one at that hour
$63 of frontage, recovered

quests.title: The Clock at Mulgrave
quests.blurb: The clock on the Mulgrave platform has been four minutes fast since I got here and every relief who comes through wants to fix it. Do not fix it. Find out who set it that way, before they retire.

steps.label: the clock, four minutes fast, for the file
to Windsor, where the old crew drink
bring the name back

quests.title: The Dog at St James
quests.blurb: A dog meets the 5:40 at St James every weekday and nobody gets off for it. Four months of this. I have decided it is not going to be a sad story. Find out whose it is.

steps.label: the end of the platform, at twenty to six
the street it walks home to
tell me it is not a sad story

quests.title: The Book at Marion
quests.blurb: I run a small book on things that are not races — weather, delays, whether the twenty past four out of Marion runs on time. Somebody is beating it by information, not luck. Ride the run they ride.

steps.label: ride the run they ride
the two who follow you off it
$111 back off the book

quests.title: Last Service out of Chinatown
quests.blurb: Nothing runs out of Chinatown after half six. I lock this end and a fella with a rescue greyhound locks the other and in between there is a kilometre of lit platform for nobody. Ride the last one to Capitol Square and bring me a photograph of that.

steps.label: ride the late one to Capitol Square
the empty platform, lit and pointless
tell them what you saw

quests.title: The Padstow Tap-Off
quests.blurb: A card ending 68 boards at Padstow on every second Friday and vanishes. Not a fare thing — ninety cents. I want to know *how*, and nobody upstairs wants to hear it.

steps.label: ride the run the card rides
the gap in the fence everyone knows about
photograph it before somebody welds it

quests.title: The Bondi Junction Order
quests.blurb: I have made the same order for the same person every morning since I opened at Bondi Junction. Since school holidays they have not turned up, and nobody will put it in writing. Go and knock.

steps.label: order one at the Bondi Junction kiosk
the office they walk to, or used to
come back with $114 — I am not running a charity

quests.title: Four Minutes at Milsons Point
quests.blurb: The board at Milsons Point says four minutes. It has said four minutes since before the merge and it is a lie about a third of the time. Stand under it, time it, and bring me numbers instead of feelings.

steps.label: stand under the board and wait like everyone else
photograph the board saying four minutes
ride the one that finally comes
give me the number

quests.title: Unclaimed at Tempe
quests.blurb: Somebody lost something off the Tempe line on Thursdays and has not come for it, which never happens. Find out why not.

steps.label: the address on the tag
the two who got there before you
$94 — whatever it is, it is worth that to somebody

quests.title: The Quiet Carriage, Coalcliff
quests.blurb: Speakerphone. A Tuesday, Coalcliff to town, speakerphone. I have made eye contact eleven times and it has achieved nothing.

steps.label: ride the quiet carriage and observe the crime
apply the shame manually
photograph the sign, for the record

quests.title: The Victoria Cross Shortcut
quests.blurb: Every courier has a route that is not on a map and mine goes through Victoria Cross. They have started locking one end. Go and find out whether it is locked forever or just locked today.

steps.label: the end they lock
the long way round, so you understand what it costs
$98, which is what the long way costs me a week

quests.title: Possession at Concord West
quests.blurb: Third time at Concord West on the long weekend. Not kids — kids run. This one walks, and I am past being reasonable about it. I need it stopped before somebody writes a very long report about me.

steps.label: where they come through the fence
the ones who think a hard hat is a costume
photograph the gap so I can put a number on the form

quests.title: The Museum Regular
quests.blurb: A man drank in my front bar by Museum for 7 years and then stopped, and every regular in here has gone vague on me at once, which means they know. You are not from here. Go and knock.

steps.label: the house they say he moved to
you cannot ask a favour empty-handed
come back and tell me straight

quests.title: Bay 14, UNSW High Street
quests.blurb: People have started parking on the grass at UNSW High Street because of one abandoned car, and I am past being reasonable about it. Photograph it, and the date on the ticket, so somebody can be embarrassed by it.

steps.label: the car, and the ticket, and the date on it
the two arguing over the grass
$58 in fines nobody is going to collect

quests.title: Whatever Is Under the Grey at Town Hall
quests.blurb: One colour, grey, the same grey in Town Hall as in every other suburb. I would like something of this one to exist afterwards, and I have stopped filling in the form.

steps.label: the wall, before they get to it
photograph it properly, not a phone-in-a-hurry job
show me
